sentences.text: In the October AMT-208 steering committee, the decision was that dosing stays at 20 mg for all new patients until the data monitoring committee completed its review of the liver data.

citations.quote: We lift the hold: dose escalation to 30 mg resumes

sentences.text: Dr. Elena Ortiz agreed that until the amendment is approved, new patients stay at 20 mg, so that is the current dose for new patients.

citations.quote: Until the amendment is approved, new patients stay at 20 mg.

sentences.text: One of those patients briefly went above three times the upper limit, which is why the committee asked.

citations.quote: One patient briefly, yes. That's why they asked.

sentences.text: Dr. Hana Sato said no one should be escalated to 30 mg until the committee had seen the full listings.

citations.quote: I don't think we can escalate anyone to 30 mg until the committee has seen the full listings.
